title: Accumulator machine
description: A machine has one accumulator that starts at 0 and runs a list of commands in order. Each command has an op name and a number n. `add` adds n to the accumulator; `sub` subtracts n; `mul` multiplies the accumulator by n; `show` prints `acc = V` with the current value (n is ignored); `halt` prints `halted at command N` and stops immediately, so no later command runs (n is ignored); any other op prints `command N: unknown op [OP]` and is otherwise skipped. N is the command's position counted from 1, and op names are case-sensitive. Return the final accumulator value.
notes: Level 3. State threaded through steps, early exit (halt), a fall-through default case, output interleaved with computation. Case-sensitive ops; empty op is unknown. Largest value 4e15 < 2^53.
